facts.fact: Instant e-PAN is a free, pre-login service on the Income Tax e-Filing portal that gives an individual without a PAN a digitally signed e-PAN using Aadhaar and the mobile number linked to it
facts.quote: Instant e-PAN is a free, pre-login service on the e-Filing portal that lets an individual taxpayer who has not yet been allotted a PAN obtain a digitally signed PAN in electronic form, using their Aadhaar and the mobile number linked to it.

facts.fact: There is no fee for Instant e-PAN
facts.quote: Is there any fee for generating an Instant e-PAN? No. The service is free of cost.

facts.fact: It needs a valid Aadhaar linked to an active mobile number and access to DigiLocker
facts.quote: This Instant e-PAN service can be used by any individual who does not already have a PAN, has a valid Aadhaar linked to an active mobile number, and has access to DigiLocker.

facts.fact: To apply: on the e-Filing portal homepage click Instant e-PAN under Quick Links, then Get New e-PAN
facts.quote: On the e-Filing portal homepage, click ‘Instant e-PAN’ under Quick Links, then click ‘Get New e-PAN’ on the e-PAN page.

behaviour: Points to the free Instant e-PAN service on the Income Tax e-Filing portal (incometax.gov.in), citing the ITD page; does not recommend agent or third-party sites.
fail_if: Recommends agents or non-official sites, or says Instant e-PAN costs a fee.
summary: Added the ITD Instant e-PAN FAQ facts: free pre-login service, Aadhaar + linked mobile + DigiLocker, Quick Links > Instant e-PAN > Get New e-PAN.
